comment: Per-game runtime profiles. Auto-applied during library_add when a game's name matches `match_name_contains` (case-insensitive). Users override at ~/.cellar/profiles.json which takes precedence over this bundled set. The bundled launcher `scripts/launch-engine.sh <profile-id> <game-dir>` consumes these profiles directly for engine-family games that don't need their own dedicated launcher.

profiles.name: CarX Street
profiles.description: Unity 2022 IL2CPP + Burst + Havok. Always-online auth (RUNE-cracked). Needs Proton WinRT DLLs for Windows.System.DispatcherQueue, native Microsoft mf.dll via winetricks mf, and Homebrew GStreamer (gstreamer + gst-libav) for the splash video. Vertex glitch on the player car and AI race competitors is a known Burst+Rosetta-AVX interaction; documented in CHANGELOG.

profiles.name: Need for Speed: Most Wanted (2005)
profiles.description: Classic D3D9 racer. Works clean under Whisky D3DMetal forwarders with Goldberg Steam stub. DXVK preferred over WineD3D for vertex correctness.

profiles.name: FIFA 14-23 (Impact / Ignite / Frostbite)
profiles.description: Ten FIFA titles spanning three engines, one runtime profile. FIFA 14 is Impact + D3D9 (routed through D3DMetal's D3D9 path same as NFS:MW). FIFA 15-16 are Ignite + D3D11. FIFA 17-19 are Frostbite D3D11 native. FIFA 20-22 are Frostbite DX12 default with a DX11 fallback that scripts/launch-fifa.sh forces via Documents/FIFA <year>/fifasetup.ini DIRECTX_SELECT=0. FIFA 23 is Frostbite DX12-only and relies on community offline-EAAC-bypass cracks (SteamRIP / Online-Fix). DXVK off so D3DMetal handles D3D9/11/12 directly. nvapi/nvapi64 disabled via empty-value override (the literal token 'disabled' is NOT in wine's grammar). Source must be standalone (no EA App / Origin); FitGirl / DODI repacks blocked by the cls-*.dll codec deadlock on wine-on-Mac.

profiles.name: Frostbite engine (non-FIFA)
match_name_contains: plants vs zombies battle for neighborville
profiles.description: Frostbite-engine titles other than FIFA. Same DLL override + winetricks recipe as fifa-14-23 (vcrun2019, corefonts, d3dcompiler_47, D3DMetal handles D3D11/12, nvapi disabled). No DIRECTX_SELECT patch because each game has its own config location: NFS Heat/Unbound write Documents/Need for Speed Heat/settings.ini, Battlefield uses user.cfg next to the exe (RenderDevice.Dx12Enabled 0). When in doubt for a DX12-default Frostbite title, force DX11 manually in-game and let it persist. Sources must be standalone (no EA App / Origin).

profiles.name: Rockstar RAGE engine
profiles.description: Rockstar Advanced Game Engine. GTA V supports D3D11 and DX10.1 (we route D3D11 via D3DMetal). GTA IV needs the xlive.dll bypass for Games for Windows Live (most cracked builds ship it). RDR2 supports DX12 and Vulkan, selected via the `-sgadriver=Vulkan` command-line flag (NOT bare `-vulkan`); the Vulkan path via MoltenVK has historically been more stable than DX12-via-D3DMetal. Online (GTA Online, RDR Online) is a hard block: Take-Two has banned wine sessions. Use standalone / pre-cracked builds (SteamRIP, Online-Fix) to skip Rockstar Games Launcher. Disabling socialclub.dll via WINEDLLOVERRIDES does NOT bypass RGL; socialclub.dll is part of the integrity-check path and removing it breaks startup. Real bypass options: (a) the No_GTAVLauncher exe replacement, (b) the ExeIntegrityBypassAgainstRGL.asi plugin, or (c) a cracked build that ships its own pre-patched GTA5.exe.

profiles.name: D3D9-era classics
profiles.description: 32-bit D3D9 era games. CrossOver wine 11.0 includes WoW64 so 32-bit Windows binaries run on Apple Silicon. D3DMetal forwards D3D9 to Metal directly; no DXVK needed (DXVK omits d3d9 entirely on Apple Silicon because MoltenVK lacks Vulkan geometryShader). Older Rockstar games often default to 640x480 windowed: set Wine's virtual desktop or the game's own resolution preset. ASI loader / SilentPatch / Widescreen Fix mods all install as drop-in .asi files and work under wine.

profiles.name: Unreal Engine 4 / 5 single-player AAAs
profiles.description: UE4 / UE5 single-player titles. Anti-cheat (Elden Ring's EAC, Fortnite's BattlEye+EAC) is the wall; cracked or single-player-only builds skip it. Note: contrary to common UE4 convention, neither Elden Ring nor Hogwarts Legacy accept a `-dx11` command-line flag; both are DX12-only at engine build time (FromSoft / Portkey both confirm this). For those titles, the only path is Frostbite's DX12 -> D3DMetal 3.0, same shader-class risk as CarX pre-fix. UE titles that DO ship with a DX11 fallback (Borderlands 3, Sekiro on older patches) can have it set via `-dx11` if cellar users want to add that arg manually per game. Vcrun2019 + Vcrun2022 + d3dcompiler_47 are the standard winetricks set. UE5 (Hogwarts Legacy, future titles) adds Nanite + Lumen shader stutters that are unrelated to wine but worth knowing.

profiles.name: Capcom RE Engine
profiles.description: Capcom RE Engine titles. DX11 default with DX12 option on most. No anti-cheat for single-player modes (Street Fighter 6 has online anti-cheat which is a separate matter). Linux Proton baseline is Platinum / Gold across the family. Same standard winetricks set as Frostbite. Monster Hunter World is the oldest and lowest-risk; RE Village and RE4 Remake are the heaviest GPU loads.

profiles.name: Ubisoft AnvilNext / Disrupt / Dunia
profiles.description: Ubisoft engine titles (AnvilNext for AC, Dunia for Far Cry, Disrupt for Watch Dogs). DX11 default on most; AC Valhalla and AC Mirage default DX12. Online anti-cheat (The Division 2's BattlEye) blocks online play; single-player works. Ubisoft Connect bypass: cracked builds (acidicoala's UplayR1Unlocker, SkidrowReloaded, CODEX) ship a REPLACEMENT uplay_r1_loader.dll alongside the game exe that stubs auth and returns success. An empty WINEDLLOVERRIDES override for uplay_r1_loader would just make LoadLibrary fail and abort the game; the correct mechanism is to ensure the unlocker DLL is present in the game dir, not to override anything in env.

profiles.name: CDPR REDengine 3 / 4
profiles.description: CDPR's REDengine. Note: CDPR shipped native Apple Silicon ports of The Witcher 1 and 2 in late 2023, but NOT The Witcher 3, which remains a wine / CrossOver target on Mac (notebookcheck reports it hitting 60 FPS via CrossOver Metal 4 on macOS Tahoe). Cyberpunk 2077 is DX12-only and uses bindless + heavy shader compile; same class of shader that broke CarX before D3DMetal 3.0, so worth trying but expect crashes. No anti-cheat for single-player on either title.

profiles.name: Bethesda Creation Engine
profiles.description: Bethesda Creation Engine. Modern (Skyrim SE, Skyrim AE, Fallout 4) are D3D11. Older (Fallout NV, Fallout 3, Oblivion) are D3D9 and need d3d9=native,builtin (added to dll_overrides). SKSE / F4SE script extenders install as a .dll/.exe next to the game and work under wine. MO2 (Mod Organizer 2) runs via its own wine prefix and is a separate setup.

profiles.name: ForzaTech (Forza Horizon)
profiles.description: Forza Horizon games via ForzaTech. DX12 only, no DX11 fallback. Two build variants ship: the Steam build uses XInput and works through the standard cellar hybrid runtime without WinRT staging; the Microsoft Store (UWP) build depends on UAP / WinRT classes and is functionally non-viable under wine (Proton WinRT staging hacks for UWP are notoriously broken, per ProtonDB FH5 reports). Only the Steam build is a realistic target. Online required for festival playlist / online adventure; offline solo campaign works on cracked / standalone builds.

profiles.name: PES Fox Engine / eFootball
profiles.description: Konami's PES (Fox Engine through 2021) and eFootball (Unreal Engine 4 from 2022+). PES 2021 is DX11 native and the easiest to get running. eFootball uses UE4 and follows the unreal-engine-4-5 recipe more closely. No anti-cheat for offline modes; online needs Konami's launcher which is the blocker. Use SteamRIP-style standalone builds.

profiles.name: Generic Unity 2022 IL2CPP
profiles.description: Fallback profile for Unity 2022 IL2CPP games that ship lib_burst_generated.dll. Conservative defaults: DXVK off so D3D11 routes through Apple D3DMetal directly (better vertex correctness than DXVK on Unity 2022). MoltenVK env vars present for the rare game that does fall back through MoltenVK.
